193	// the reduce + optimizer phases read them directly. This also lets the host side

198	                         float* __restrict__ params,
199	                         DecoderTokenCtx tok,
200	                         float* __restrict__ grad,        // reduced grad [total]
201	                         float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {

203	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
204	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
205	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
206	    const int64_t total = kDecTotalElems;
207	    float* my_partial = tok.workspace + (int64_t)cta * total;   // this CTA's dW
208	    float* loss_part = tok.workspace + (int64_t)nCTA * total;   // [nCTA]

212	    // warp-specialize prims live in sg::sm90::wgs (this file is sg::fused::sm90)

219	    bar.sync();   // B0
220	
221	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
222	    DecWeights w = dec_bind(params);
223	    DecGrad g = dec_bind_grad(my_partial);
224	    // Even split with remainder to the low CTAs (contiguous, deterministic).
225	    const int B = tok.B;
226	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
227	    const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
228	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
229	    const int b1 = b0 + cnt;
230	    __shared__ int tok_s[dec::kSeq];   // this sample's token ids (broadcast)

232	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;              // fp32 slice accumulator (thread-0 holds it)

234	        if (threadIdx.x < dec::kSeq) tok_s[threadIdx.x] = tok.tokens[(int64_t)b * dec::kSeq + threadIdx.x];
235	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = tok.targets[b];
236	        __syncthreads();
237	        float nll = dec_forward_sample(w, tok_s, tgt_s, &sm);
238	        dec_backward_sample(w, g, tok_s, tgt_s, B, &sm);
239	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;   // fixed-order fp32 sum within slice
240	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
241	    }
242	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
243	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete

246	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
247	    //    ascending CTA index). The summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed, so
248	    //    the result is deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ────

251	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
252	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kDecNumTensors;
253	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
254	            const int n = kDecSizes[t];
255	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kDecOffsets[t];
256	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x) {
257	                float acc = 0.0f;
258	                // ascending CTA index → fixed fp32 summation order (deterministic).

260	                    acc += tok.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];

262	            }

296	//    refuse (the GridBarrier rendezvous of n_ctas CTAs can never complete if a
297	//    CTA can't be placed). Zeroes the barrier+task counters per launch. ─────────
298	template <OptId Opt>
299	cudaError_t launch_fused_decoder_megakernel(
300	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, DecoderTokenCtx tok,
301	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
302	    int dev = 0;
303	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
304	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
305	    int n_sms = 0;
306	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
307	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
308	
309	    int occ = 0;
310	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
311	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_decoder_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
312	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/0);
313	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
314	    // Hang-freedom: at least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier
315	    // can never be satisfied. The L3-REAL kernel uses ≈42 KB static smem + a high
316	    // register count; if it cannot place one block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
317	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
318	           "fused_decoder_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The "
319	           "decoder smem (~42KB) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM occupancy; "
320	           "reduce footprint or fall back to the L1 per-op path.");
321	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
322	
323	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
324	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
325	
326	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
327	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
328	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
329	
330	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
331	    fused_decoder_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, 0, stream>>>(
332	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st);
333	    return cudaGetLastError();
334	}

This header defines the **decoder L3-TC persistent wgmma megakernel** (production path) plus a gated legacy fp32 scalar twin. Two `__global__` kernels + two host launchers + the workspace-carve helper algebra + `rebase_state`.

---

## 1. Top-level structure / compile seams (lines 1–138)

- **`SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL`** GEMM-engine selector (lines 54–92): integer token, `SG_GEMM_IMPL_SCALAR=0` (default), `SG_GEMM_IMPL_WGMMA=1`. `#ifndef` default = SCALAR (line 86–88). An out-of-range token is a hard `#error` (lines 89–92).
- **WGMMA include block** (lines 99–116, only under `SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL==1`): pulls in `model_stage_decoder_tc.cuh` (the validated GEMM engine), `opt_stages_precompute.cuh` (older work-steal Prodigy/Muon helpers — comment says the TC Prodigy branch uses an INLINE fixed-partition reduce, the work-steal helpers are "retained for the dormant mamba path"), and `opt_stage_supergrok2.cuh` (full CSA/HCA/PEER/GRU meta-net + in-kernel segmented sort).
- **`SG_DEC_SCALAR_MEGAKERNEL`** gate (lines 118–138): default **1 (ON)**. Gates the LEGACY fp32 scalar `fused_decoder_megakernel<Opt>`. Rationale (lines 127–135): the scalar path's `DecSampleSmem` is sized `[kSeq×kD]/[kSeq×kDff]` so its STATIC smem grows with `SG_DEC_D` and ptxas hard-stops at d≥768; the TC engine's `DecTcSmem` (~13.5–18 KB) is d-independent. Turning the scalar gate OFF lets the whole extension compile at scaled d. Default 1 keeps the d=128 production build byte-identical.
- Namespace: `sg::fused::sm90` (line 140). The warp-specialize prims are in `sg::sm90::wgs` (note line 212).

## 2. `rebase_state<Opt>` (lines 145–163)

Copies a `FusedOptState` and adds `off` to every per-ELEMENT state pointer (exp_avg, exp_avg_sq, ema, sam_dir, s_track, mu, orth, smart_grad, param_init, sharpness). Per-TENSOR weight sets (NeuralGrok psi MLP, SG11/15 `sg_phi_W1/b1/W2`) and scalars pass through UNCHANGED (lines 158–161 explicitly note phi weights are NOT rebased). Each `+= off` is guarded by an `if` (null-safe).

## 3. `DecoderTokenCtx` (lines 175–181)

`tokens [B,kSeq] int32`, `targets [B] int32`, `B`, `workspace` (grad partials + loss partials + reduced loss), `loss_out` device float. Workspace layout comment (lines 169–173): `[0..nCTA*total)` per-CTA grad partials (cta-major), `[nCTA*total..+nCTA)` per-CTA loss, `[+1)` reduced loss. `total == kDecTotalElems == 422755`.

- **P0** (216–219): each CTA zeroes its OWN `my_partial[total]` slice + its loss slot, `bar.sync()` = **B0**.
- **P1** (221–243): batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Even split with remainder to LOW CTAs (`base=B/nCTA, rem=B%nCTA`, lines 226–229). Per-sample: broadcast tokens to `tok_s[kSeq]`, `dec_forward_sample` → nll, `dec_backward_sample` accumulates into `g` (this CTA's partial). nll summed thread-0 fixed-order fp32 (line 239). `loss_part[cta]=nll_acc`, `bar.sync()` = **B1**.
- **P2** (245–273): deterministic cross-CTA reduce via TaskQueue over the 30 tensors (one task = one tensor). For each element, sum `tok.workspace[c*total+off+i]` in **ASCENDING CTA index** (fixed fp32 order → deterministic; lines 259–261) into `grad[off+i]`.
